public_rationale: Contemporaneous studies document weak autonomous planning, but successful LLM-plus-planner systems prevent a blanket inference about every LLM-based system. Those hybrid results also do not establish the full conversational and world-tracking comparison. The undefined reliability threshold and task scope materially affect the answer, so neither support nor contradiction is secure.
limitations: Planning benchmarks cover only part of the ordinary SHRDLU comparison.
Failure to locate a complete qualifying system does not prove that none existed.
The authors' private knowledge cannot be independently assessed.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: As far as the authors know, no LLM-based system can yet reliably do the blocks-world modeling that SHRDLU attempted in the 1970s.

statement.excerpt: To our knowledge, no LLM-based system can yet reliably do what SHRLDU tried to do then:

from_speaker: what SHRLDU tried to do then
our_interpretation: SHRLDU is read as SHRDLU, the system identified in the surrounding text.
The checkable proposition concerns publicly demonstrated capabilities, not the authors' private knowledge.
The ordinary comparison covers consistent blocks-world understanding, state tracking and execution of language-directed manipulations across an exchange.
LLM-based systems include systems that combine an LLM with an external planner; the claim does not explicitly exclude them.
Reliably means repeatable success across varied relevant tasks, rather than a selected successful demonstration. No numerical cutoff is supplied.
For the ongoing capability state, I use January 1–October 21, 2023, the current research reporting year through publication.
criteria.support_condition: Broad contemporaneous evaluations covering relevant LLM-based systems, including hybrids, establish persistent failures across the SHRDLU-style task bundle and identify no reliable qualifying system.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A publicly documented system existing by October 21, 2023 repeatedly performs comparable blocks-world language understanding, state tracking and manipulation reliably.

evidence.explanation: The study reports limited autonomous planning performance, including an approximately 12% cross-domain average for GPT-4, alongside more promising assisted approaches. These results do not establish that every LLM-based system lacked the full claimed capability.

LLM+P combines language-model translation with a classical planner and reports successful planning across benchmark domains. This is material counterevidence to excluding all LLM-based systems, but it does not establish reliable performance across the full conversational comparison.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Contemporaneous records of a qualifying system, or broad evaluations against a clearly specified SHRDLU-style task suite, including hybrid systems and repeated reliability measurements.
